a band key names a configured course and a band from A1 to C2, so a configured course with an unknown band is refused before a write (SPEC-073 A4); cargo-mutants deletes no operand of a conjunction

three complete ladders report the top review rung at 100% (SPEC-073 A18); cargo-mutants never mutates a float literal

GET /api/badges takes the owner's session before it reads anything, so no session, an unknown one or an ended one answers 401 with the reason alone and no badge data (SPEC-073 A20, R16)
GET /api/records takes the owner's session before it reads anything, so a request without the owner's live session answers 401 and no record data (SPEC-073 A20, R17)
GET /api/milestone takes the owner's session too, so even its pending answer is the owner's alone (SPEC-073 A20, R17)
the milestone route answers exactly {"status": "pending"}, read from nothing, while Road to C2 supplies no mature-card sum (SPEC-073 R15, R17; #85)
a record today already reaches is at no distance, never a negative one: the fixture's minutes record is 8 against today's 10 and answers 0 (SPEC-073 A24, R19)

a locked badge's progress answers its input's value against its own threshold, so a three-day streak reads 3 of 30 for the monthly badge; a json! argument, which cargo-mutants never mutates (SPEC-073 A23, R16)
/badges lists at most the 20 most recently awarded badges: at 21 earned the oldest drops out; cargo-mutants never mutates a constant (SPEC-073 A21, R18)
/records closes with the line naming the record today is closest to, by that record's own label (SPEC-073 A22, R18)
the earned badges are ordered newest award first, then by key and tier; the mutant is the predecessor's oldest-first order (SPEC-073 A21, R18)
a locked streak badge's progress reads the stored streak, never another input (SPEC-073 A23, R16)
the monthly streak badge's threshold is 30, the streak its condition holds at and not one below; a literal in a match arm, which cargo-mutants never mutates (SPEC-073 A23, R16)
